fr_cycle_noun.hook: A gentleman in a top hat rides a tall old-fashioned high-wheel bicycle round and round in a never-ending CYCLE.
fr_cycle_noun.why: Source hook says 'penny-farthing', which trips the content word filter; same picture, different wording.

fr_mobylette_noun.hook: A baker rides a little MOPED with MOBY the whale painted on its delivery box, baguettes tied on the back (mo-bee-LET).
fr_mobylette_noun.why: Matches the painting: the whale is on the moped's delivery box, not its tank.

fr_taxi_noun.hook: A moustached TAXI driver in a red cap stands by his yellow cab, frowning at the TAX bill in his hand.
fr_taxi_noun.why: Owner review 2026-10-25: no anthropomorphic animal unless it is the hook; the fox driver is repainted as a man, and the lorry no longer overlaps the cab.

fr_carrefour_noun.hook: Three cars wait their turn at a four-way CROSSROADS, with a signpost on the corner: a CAR FOR (kar-FOOR) every road.
fr_carrefour_noun.why: Owner review 2026-10-25: the crossroads looked weird; repainted as a clear four-way junction.

fr_stationnement_noun.hook: A moustached STATION MASTER with a whistle guards a black car standing by the old meter: PARKING (sta-syon-MAHN).
fr_stationnement_noun.why: Owner review 2026-10-25: parking faces were weird; attendant face repainted clearly, with the whistle now visible.
